title: Contact
slide_intent: Give readers a clear person to approach when applying the identity raises a question.
strategic_value: A named museum contact can help staff resolve an unfamiliar brand use and connect that decision to the institution.
demonstration: A dark green closing page identifies the Head of Communications, lists contact channels and credits Spy for the identity and design.
practical_value: Route a question about the source guidelines to the printed museum contact and distinguish that role from the design credit.

content_islands.name: Section and title
content_islands.spec: Place the 9.0 Contact section marker at upper left and a large white Contact title below.

content_islands.name: Museum contact
content_islands.spec: Stack the instruction, contact name, role and contact channels beneath the title. Use weight to make the name easy to find.

content_islands.name: Design credit
content_islands.spec: Place the small Spy credit below the contact block. Keep the remainder of the green field open.
